evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
ABOUT THE GAME

 Olympus lies fractured as Hades has unleashed the four titans upon the gods. Now they roam freely destroying everything in their path. Thunder echoes across the realm as Zeus refuses to yield – yet even he cannot restore the balance alone. No, he turns to you, a mere mortal, to wield his lightning, challenge the darkness, and ascend toward mythic glory.

 Stand with the god of gods in Zeus Ze Zecond, a 6-reel, 5-row game with paylines and a max win of 20 000 times your bet available in every game mode.

 Forge your path through the storm, and let the ascent begin.
